name: thousand-refractions-prepare-1-paid-wakes-champion-returns-to-hand
notes: Thousand Refractions (XLbCBxla8K, LUXEM ASSASSIN ATTACK, reserve 0, printed power 1): "Prepare 1. [Class Bonus] On Hit: If Thousand Refractions was prepared, wake up your champion and return Thousand Refractions to its owner's hand." Player 2's champion is Tristan, Shadowdancer (ASSASSIN, UMBRA) patched in with extra lineage cards to unlock the card's element; ATTACK cards cannot be played by the first player on turn 1, so player 1 ends turn 1 and player 2 plays the card with real actions (10002 FSM play, 100 reserve payments / YES-NO answer / attack target). The card is free (reserve 0), so the Prepare prompt follows the play directly. Player 2 pays Prepare 1; the champion rests to attack (Status 1) and the On Hit wakes it (Status 2) and returns the card to hand instead of the graveyard.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Hit: If Thousand Refractions was prepared, wake up your champion and return Thousand Refractions to its owner's hand.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The CardEditor ability row for this card never queued the fixed Prepare cost: no $cardActivatedAbilities['XLbCBxla8K:0'] entry existed (or, for the Strike from the Mist stub, it was an empty '(engine)' body), so OnCardActivated() queued no 'Pay Prepare N?' decision and wasPrepared was never YES. Live state dump on HEAD 47028d36 before the fix: after the last reserve payment the decision queue went straight to the attack-target / ally-target choice (no YESNO), preparation counters stayed untouched, and answering YES was rejected as 'Invalid selection' (or silently ignored) -- so the card's 'if prepared' rider was unreachable. Fix: hand-authored $cardActivatedAbilities['XLbCBxla8K:0'] (GAQueueFixedPrepare(player, 1)); the generated onHit (wake up + return, now re-gated on ASSASSIN by GAWrapClassBonusGate) already existed but could never see PREPARED.
